cards.subject: Brightwood
cards.title: It used to be called Brightwood.
cards.body: Grand Hamlet, Raven Hill, orchards. When Medivh died the fel that had been in him went into the ground, and the forest has not seen the sun since. The spiders were Elwynn's spiders once.

cards.subject: Stitches
cards.title: Something walks the road from Raven Hill to Darkshire.
cards.body: A level 35 elite in a zone that tops out at 30. Two sets of Night Watch stand in its way, at the ogre mound and outside the Rotting Orchard, and without help it kills both. It says one thing: DARKSHIRE… I HUNGER.

cards.subject: Mor'Ladim
cards.title: Do not run through Raven Hill Cemetery.
cards.body: Mor'Ladim patrols it, and his aggro radius is far bigger than anything else at this level. Every Alliance player has a story about him. Most of them end at the graveyard.

cards.subject: Archeus
cards.title: Mor'Ladim was Morgan Ladimore.
cards.body: A knight who fought beside Uther, came home to find his wife and children buried at Raven Hill, and swung his sword at the gravestones until he had killed the attendants. Then himself. The sword was Archeus. When he finally falls, his spirit says he needs it no longer.

cards.subject: Twilight Grove
cards.title: There is a night elf grove in the middle of the zone.
cards.body: A moonwell, a gazebo and a great tree, walled in by hills so that most players never find the way in. The tree was planted from a branch of Nordrassil by Fandral Staghelm, and it is one of four doors into the Emerald Dream.

cards.subject: Raven Hill
cards.title: Raven Hill graduated the finest embalmers in Azeroth.
cards.body: That was the town's whole trade: a mortuary school. Now two people live there, Jitters and a goblin vendor. Everyone else fled east to Darkshire after the dead they had prepared got up. The catacombs under the cemetery are still there.

cards.subject: Abercrombie
cards.title: The hermit by the cemetery is a necromancer.
cards.body: Abercrombie's errands — the comb, the juice, the rot blossoms — are the recipe for Stitches. His wife Eliza died and he put his own heart in her chest to bring her back. It worked, in the way these things work.

cards.subject: Stalvan Mistmantle
cards.title: Thirteen quests to learn one man's name.
cards.body: The Legend of Stalvan sends you to Stormwind, Goldshire and Moonbrook for letters and a ring before it lets you into Manor Mistmantle. A tutor who wanted his student, who was promised to someone else. Nobody who finishes it forgets it.

cards.subject: Roland's Doom
cards.title: The worgen came out of a mine.
cards.body: Roland's Doom, east of the Rotting Orchard. A night elf priestess carried the Scythe of Elune here and died with it; Jitters found it, and the Nightbane pack followed. He has been shaking ever since.

cards.subject: Morbent Fel
cards.title: One necromancer is why the dead walk here.
cards.body: Morbent Fel, in the Forlorn Rowe above Raven Hill, holds every corpse in the zone. The chain to reach him starts with Sven, at a campfire near the river, whose family he took.
